headline: Chip startup Bolt Graphics is reportedly trying to raise about $100 million at a valuation of around $700 million to build chips that rival Nvidia and AMD.
score_reason: Pool score kept: small funding round based on anonymous sources, with terms that may change.
importance_line: It tests whether investors will back chip startups outside AI, but the figures come from unnamed sources and may change.
summary: Reuters reports, as carried by ET CIO and citing three people familiar with the matter, that Bolt Graphics, a Silicon Valley chip-design startup, is seeking about $100 million at a valuation of roughly $700 million. Chief executive Darwesh Singh declined to give terms but said fundraising is "well under way", and the company aims its Zeus chip at scientific computing and professional graphics rather than AI.
notes: Reuters text via ET CIO; original Reuters link not given.
